description_en: Queries the top 100 hot keys within a specified time period
description_zh: 调用DescribeTopHotKeys接口，获取一段时间内排名前100的热Key
kebab_example: aliyun das describe-top-hot-keys --console-context None --instance-id r-bp18ff4a195d0000 --node-id r-0000-db-0 --start-time 1596177993000 --end-time 1596177993001 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeTopHotKeys

parameters.description_en: The ID of the Redis instance.

parameters.name: node_id

parameters.description_en: The start of the query time range, specified as a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.
parameters.description_zh: 查询任务开始时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位为毫秒。
parameters.help_en: The start of the query time range, specified as a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询任务开始时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位为毫秒
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.description_en:
The end of the query time range, specified as a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.

> - The end time must be later than the start time.
>
> - You can query data within the last four days.
>
> - The maximum time interval between **StartTime** and **EndTime** is three hours.
parameters.description_zh:
查询任务结束时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位为毫秒。
> - 查询任务结束时间需晚于查询任务开始时间。
> - 仅支持最大查询时间范围为4天内的数据。
> - **StartTime**和**EndTime**最大查询间隔为3小时内。
